text: Dice only, the heuristic flag removed, imitation until entropy 0.6 (reached the 60 iteration cap at 1.26), entropy bonus 0.02.
Entropy rose from 1.26 to 2.07 and the sampled win rate fell to 15%: the entropy bonus 0.02 was too strong. Stopped at iteration 290 of 460 to start the full player.
Best checkpoint on 4,000 new matches: 39.7% (CI 38.2% to 41.2%) vs Aggressive 38.1% (CI 36.6% to 39.6%). Ahead by 1.6 points, not significant; mean CP margin -0.84 vs -1.28.
